title: Synonyms, Antonyms, and Homophones
description: Word relationship practice. Synonyms (words with similar meanings), antonyms (opposites), and homophones (words that sound alike but are spelled differently and mean different things).
subject: language-arts
source: Common Core ELA vocabulary standards L.2.5, L.3.5, L.4.5, L.5.5. Word selection drawn from typical grade-level vocabulary lists.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of big?
items.context: Big and large mean the same thing. Small is the opposite of big.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of happy?
items.context: Glad means happy. Sad is the opposite, and mad means angry.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of fast?
items.context: Quick and fast mean the same thing. Slow is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of start?
items.context: Start and begin mean the same thing. Stop, end, and finish are about the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of little?
items.context: Little and small mean the same thing. Huge is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of hot?
items.context: Hot and cold are opposites. Warm is close to hot, so it isn't the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of up?
items.context: Up and down are opposites. Under is the opposite of over.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of day?
items.context: Day and night are opposites: day is light and night is dark. Morning and noon are parts of the day.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of full?
items.context: Full means there's no room left. Empty means nothing is inside. They are opposites.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of see?
items.context: See means to look at something. Sea is a large body of salt water. They sound alike but mean different things.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank: 'I want ___ play outside.'
items.context: 'To' is the little word in 'want to play' and 'go to the park.' 'Too' means also or very (me too!). 'Two' is the number 2. 'Tow' means to pull, like a tow truck.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of quiet?
items.context: Silent means making no sound at all, which is very quiet. Loud is the opposite of quiet.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of shout?
items.context: Shout and yell both mean to call out loudly. Whisper and mumble are quiet ways to talk.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of smart?
items.context: Clever means smart: good at figuring things out. Silly and slow don't mean smart.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of brave?
items.context: Brave means ready to face something scary. Afraid is the opposite. Bold means almost the same as brave.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of gather?
items.context: To gather is to bring things together in one place. To scatter is to spread them all over. Collect means the same as gather.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of their?
items.context: Their shows ownership (their book). There is a place (over there). They're is a contraction for 'they are'. All three sound the same.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of knight?
items.context: A knight was a soldier in armor long ago. Night is when it's dark outside. The K in knight is silent, so they sound the same.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of hear?
items.context: Hear means to listen with your ears. Here means in this place.
items.mnemonic: You hear with your ear (both end in -ear).

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of courageous?
items.context: Courageous means full of courage, which is the same as brave. Scared is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of enormous?
items.context: Enormous means very, very big, just like huge. Tiny is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of examine?
items.context: To examine something is to look at it closely, like a doctor does. Inspect means the same. Ignore is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of ancient?
items.context: Ancient means very, very old, like the pyramids. Modern means new, from today. Old and historic are close to ancient, not opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of arrive?
items.context: To arrive is to get to a place. To depart is to leave it. Come means almost the same as arrive.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of peace?
items.context: Peace means calm or no war. Piece means a part of something (a piece of pie).

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of weather?
items.context: Weather is what it's like outside: sunny, rainy, or windy. Whether means 'if' (I don't know whether to go). They sound the same but are spelled differently.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of diligent?
items.context: A diligent person works hard and keeps at it. Lazy is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of benevolent?
items.context: Benevolent means kind and wanting to help others. 'Bene' means good, like in 'benefit.' Cruel is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of reluctant?
items.context: Reluctant means you don't really want to do something. Eager is the opposite: really wanting to.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of abundant?
items.context: Abundant means there's plenty of something. Scarce means there's very little. Plentiful means the same as abundant.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of expand?
items.context: To expand is to get bigger, like a balloon filling with air. To shrink is to get smaller. Grow and stretch are close to expand.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of principal?
items.context: Principal is the head of a school (your pal). Principle is a rule or belief. They sound identical.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of compliment?
items.context: Compliment (with an i) is a kind remark. Complement (with an e) means to complete or go well with.
items.mnemonic: A complement completes something. A compliment says 'I like it.'

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of meticulous?
items.context: Meticulous means very careful about every small detail. Careless is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of obsolete?
items.context: Obsolete means no longer used because something newer replaced it, like a VCR. Outdated means the same. Modern is the opposite.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of transparent?
items.context: Transparent means you can see through it, like a clean window. Opaque means you can't see through it at all, like a wooden door. Clear means the same as transparent.

items.prompt: Which word is an antonym of frugal?
items.context: Frugal means careful not to waste money or things. Wasteful is the opposite. Thrifty means the same as frugal.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of affect?
items.context: In everyday speech affect and effect usually sound the same. Affect is usually a verb meaning to change something (The rain affected the game). Effect is usually a noun meaning the result (The effect was huge).
items.mnemonic: A is for action (verb, affect). E is for end result (noun, effect).
